  cardMarketContent = '## Avengers: Secret Wars — The Ultimate Card Event

Avengers: Secret Wars (2027) is the grand finale of the Multiverse Saga and potentially the most significant Marvel film ever made. Based on the iconic 2015 comic event, Secret Wars could bring together characters from every Marvel universe — MCU, Fox X-Men, Sony Spider-Verse, and more.

### Key Sets

The **2027 Upper Deck Avengers: Secret Wars** set could be the most valuable card set in Marvel history. The potential for crossover characters from multiple universes, returning legacy actors, and the culmination of 20+ years of storytelling creates unprecedented collector demand.

### Market Trends

Secret Wars cards will represent the pinnacle of MCU collecting. Any returning legacy actors (Tobey Maguire, Andrew Garfield, Hugh Jackman, etc.) would create astronomical demand. The event nature of the film means every card from this set carries premium.',

  content = '## The War to End All Wars

Avengers: Secret Wars is the grand finale of the Multiverse Saga and potentially the most ambitious film in cinema history. Based on Jonathan Hickman''s legendary 2015 Secret Wars comic, the film promises to bring together heroes and villains from across the entire multiverse for a battle that will reshape reality itself. With the Russo Brothers directing and Robert Downey Jr.''s Doctor Doom as the central threat, this is the culmination of everything the MCU has built.

## The Legacy

- **Grand Finale** — The conclusion of the Multiverse Saga and potentially the entire current MCU era
- **Battleworld** — The comic''s Battleworld concept could merge multiple Marvel universes into one
- **Legacy Returns** — The potential for returning actors from Fox X-Men, Sony Spider-Man, and other Marvel properties
- **Reality Reshaping** — Secret Wars could fundamentally change the MCU going forward
- **20+ Years** — The culmination of over two decades of Marvel Cinematic Universe storytelling

## Fun Facts

- The 2015 Secret Wars comic by Jonathan Hickman is considered one of the greatest Marvel events ever
- In the comics, Doctor Doom becomes God Emperor Doom, ruling over Battleworld
- Secret Wars could serve as a soft reboot for the MCU, allowing new versions of characters
- The Russo Brothers have described their return as being motivated by the Secret Wars story
- The film could potentially be the highest-grossing film of all time if it delivers on its promise

## Viewing Context

Secret Wars is the ultimate culmination film. Key viewing includes **Avengers: Doomsday** (direct prequel), **Loki** (multiverse mechanics), **Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness**, **Fantastic Four: First Steps** (Doom context), and **Deadpool & Wolverine** (multiverse/Fox legacy). Ideally, the entire MCU provides context, but the film is expected to be accessible as a massive event.',
